sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash API — Pricing & Benchmarks · OrcaRouter
sources.snippet: The model is accessible through OrcaRouter's OpenAI-compatible API, using the model ID "deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash". It is billed at provider rates with zero markup, meaning users pay exactly what OrcaRouter pays DeepSeek.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision (Exp) Is Live: Vision at Text Prices
sources.snippet: DeepSeek's first API vision model matches V4-Flash on text, adds image input at the same token prices, and pushes multimodal agents close to Opus-4.8.

sources.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: DeepSeek's first experimental multimodal V4 model — the V4-Flash MoE backbone plus a 32-layer vision tower, 1M context, and a fused DSpark draft module.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash API - OrcaRouter - AI Model APIs
sources.snippet: This model delivers cost-effective pricing at $0.15/1M input and $0.29/1M output tokens, native tool calling support, open weights architecture. Access DeepSeek V4 Flash via the OrcaRouter API with up to 384K output tokens.
